description: Render a markdown API reference from caller-supplied TypeScript type declarations: interfaces, type aliases, enums, and functions, in a pinned deterministic layout. Nothing is invented; every string comes from the input.

types.description: Type declarations to document, in document order

doc.description: Doc comment text for the declaration (optional)

members.description: Members — required for interface and enum, forbidden for type and function (see spec)

doc.description: Doc comment text for the member (optional)

optional.description: Whether the member is optional (interface members only)

name: render_api_reference
